mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.user_email AS email, u.user_role AS role, u.center_id AS centerId, u.is_super AS isSuper FROM users u WHERE u.user_email = #{email} LIMIT 1
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM customers c WHERE c.customer_id = #{customerId} LIMIT 1

SELECT c.customer_id AS customerId, c.customer_name AS name, c.customer_phone AS phone, c.customer_status AS status, c.customer_promise_time AS promiseTime, u.user_name AS staff, ( SELECT mr.room_name FROM visit_schedule vs JOIN meeting_rooms mr ON mr.room_id = vs.room_id WHERE vs.customer_id = c.customer_id ORDER BY vs.updated_at DESC, vs.visit_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS visitRoom FROM customers c LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_id = c.user_id WHERE c.customer_id = #{customerId} LIMIT 1

SELECT mc.chat_id AS chatId, mc.customer_id AS customerId, mc.author_user_id AS authorUserId, u.user_name AS authorName, mc.chat_type AS chatType, mc.content AS content, mc.created_at AS createdAt, mc.updated_at AS updatedAt, mc.is_deleted AS isDeleted FROM memo_chats mc LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_id = mc.author_user_id WHERE mc.customer_id = #{customerId} AND mc.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY mc.created_at ASC, mc.chat_id ASC

SELECT mc.chat_id AS chatId, mc.customer_id AS customerId, mc.author_user_id AS authorUserId, u.user_name AS authorName, mc.chat_type AS chatType, mc.content AS content, mc.created_at AS createdAt, mc.updated_at AS updatedAt, mc.is_deleted AS isDeleted FROM memo_chats mc LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_id = mc.author_user_id WHERE mc.chat_id = #{chatId} LIMIT 1

SELECT mc.chat_id AS chatId, mc.customer_id AS customerId, mc.author_user_id AS authorUserId, mc.chat_type AS chatType, mc.is_deleted AS isDeleted FROM memo_chats mc WHERE mc.chat_id = #{chatId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO memo_chats (customer_id, author_user_id, chat_type, content) VALUES (#{customerId}, #{authorUserId}, #{chatType}, #{content})
mapper.update: UPDATE memo_chats SET is_deleted = 1, deleted_by = #{deletedBy}, deleted_at = NOW() WHERE chat_id = #{chatId} AND is_deleted = 0
